guidance: A Work Scope Brief is an execution bridge, not a PRD, Change Request, or Bug Fix Spec. Use it when a team has sufficient evidence to build or review a bounded change but no native implementable work item yet. Capture provenance, the exact outcome, inclusions and exclusions, a repository change boundary, and testable acceptance criteria. Label observed, inferred, and unresolved statements. Do not invent scope. Do not expand this into a product framing document. After verification, Delivery Sync may append an implementation record here; it does not invent missing product history.

outline.title: Work Scope Context
outline.guidance: Anchor this brief as planned or as-built work. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Entry Mode
children.guidance: Write exactly `planned` (build from evidence) or `as-built` (review or sync a named diff, branch, or PR). Do not invent a third mode.

children.title: Outcome
children.guidance: State the observable result this bounded work must produce. Keep it to one delivery slice, not a product vision.

outline.title: Source Evidence
outline.guidance: Group the native documents, tickets, files, branches, diffs, or pasted excerpts this brief is based on. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Evidence Item
children.guidance: Title each instance with the source kind and name, not "Evidence Item".

children.title: Source Location
children.guidance: Record the SpecX document id and title when native, otherwise the URL, issue id, file path, branch, diff, or paste hash. Carry a document id separately from a display title.

children.title: Snapshot
children.guidance: Quote or paraphrase only the excerpt used as evidence. Label each claim observed, inferred, or unresolved.

children.title: Provenance
children.guidance: Record source revision, import time, and who supplied it when known. Omit if unknown.

outline.title: Delivery Scope
outline.guidance: Bound what this work changes in the repository and what it must not touch. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Inclusions
children.guidance: List the behaviours, files, or contracts in this slice.

children.title: Exclusions
children.guidance: List unrelated dirty files, neighbouring refactors, and work left for later. Unrelated existing changes must be preserved.

children.title: Change Boundary
children.guidance: Name the exact files, diff, branch, PR, or milestone boundary this work owns. Do not infer a boundary from arbitrary uncommitted files.

outline.title: Acceptance
outline.guidance: Group the testable done-conditions for this slice. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Acceptance Criterion
children.guidance: Title each instance with the observable check, not "Acceptance Criterion".

children.title: Criterion
children.guidance: State one pass/fail check. Prefer observable outcomes over adjectives.

children.title: Evidence Trace
children.guidance: Cite the source evidence item this criterion comes from. Do not invent a criterion the evidence does not contain.

outline.title: Confidence and Gaps
outline.guidance: Record assumptions and missing information without blocking safe work. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Assumptions
children.guidance: List inferences required to proceed. Label each as an assumption, not a fact.

children.title: Unresolved Gaps
children.guidance: List contradictions or missing design, environment, or contract detail. Recommend follow-up; do not invent answers. Omit if none remain.

outline.title: Delivery Context
outline.guidance: Capture how this brief is verified and recorded. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Verification Status
children.guidance: One of `pending`, `pass`, or `fail`. Do not mark pass unless Review & Verification passed this exact change boundary.

children.title: Implementation Record
children.guidance: Optional append-only leaf used after Delivery Sync. Title each instance with the date and the change, and write the record in the instance body. Do not pre-fill.
